# Let me parse the old songs from the file content. The format is "- {title} by {artists}".
import re

content = file_content['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
old_songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove the "- " prefix
        song_info = line[2:]
        # The title is everything before " by "
        if ' by ' in song_info:
            title = song_info.split(' by ')[0]
        else:
            title = song_info
        old_songs.append(title)

print(old_songs)
print(f"Number of old songs: {len(old_songs)}")
